description: Take an on-demand backup of a Cloud for WordPress site's files and database now, e.g. before a risky change. Only one on-demand backup of each type can exist: delete the old one first (otherwise BACKUP_FAILED, "Quota Reached"). It appears in list_wordpress_backups when finished, usually within a few minutes.

domain.description: Domain of the Cloud for WordPress site, e.g. `example.com`.

dry_run.description: Validate and preview without changing anything.

staging.description: true: act on the site's staging copy instead of the live site.

name: create_wordpress_backup
title: Create Wordpress Backup
